ask: How did last week do? What should we change?

steps.why: Process first: what went out last week, then how each did, best first. Posts under about a week old may not have synced (Threads every 12 hours, others about weekly): zeros there mean not synced yet, so leave them out of the ranking and say how many. No publication record: missing data, not a flop.
What still waits for a yes (total_team): drafts nobody decided explain a quiet week better than engagement does. Say only this count; nothing here says how many were decided last week.

Per account: growth, and needs_reconnect. days counts back from now, not last Monday to Sunday, so use it for the reconnect flag, not as last week's figures. A disconnected account stops syncing, so its zeros are missing data. Here Instagram needs a reconnect.
The one next step: reconnect comes before any content change, because nothing else is worth changing until Instagram syncs again.

say: Last week in Acme: 7 posts went out, and 3 drafts still wait for your yes. LinkedIn carried it: the post on hiring mistakes got 38 likes and 12 comments, about twice your other LinkedIn posts. X posts got little, but 2 of them are only 3 days old and not synced yet. Instagram is disconnected, so its numbers are missing. Reconnect it here first: <link>
never: Ranking posts that haven't synced, or reading a disconnected account's zeros as a flop.
Stating how many drafts were made or decided without a read that returned it.
Saying the hiring post caused anything beyond its own numbers, or adding a benchmark.
Offering a content change before the reconnect, or a menu of changes: exactly one next step.
